tools.name: search
tools.description: Search companies, earnings results, outlook, management quotes and call transcripts. Returns ids and links; pass an id to fetch for the full text.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get the full text for an id from search: a company's quarters and latest results, one quarter's results, or a transcript passage.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List every covered company with its latest quarter and expected next report date. Optionally filter by sector.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get a company's profile and every quarter we have, newest first, with quarter keys for get_quarter.

tools.name: get_kpis
tools.description: Quarterly KPI history from SEC XBRL filings: revenue, gross_profit, operating_income, net_income, eps_diluted, operating_cash_flow, capex, free_cash_flow, rd_expense and margins. Newest first; limit is the number of quarters.

tools.name: get_quarter
tools.description: Get one quarter's results: headline, overview, reported figures with their source sentence, segments, outlook, a check of last quarter's outlook against what was reported, takeaways, management quotes and analyst Q&A.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Get an earnings call transcript with speakers and timestamps, 100 paragraphs at a time. Pass next_offset for the next page.

tools.name: search_transcripts
tools.description: Find what was said on earnings calls, with the speaker and a link to the exact moment. Best for 'what did the CEO say about X'.

tools.name: search_earnings
tools.description: Search takeaways, outlook statements, management quotes and analyst questions across all companies. Best for themes such as tariffs or AI capex.

tools.name: list_recent
tools.description: Quarterly results reported in the last N days, newest first.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
